answer: Issue one nontransferable work lease per identity: it must lock 45 POA for ten epochs and complete two VRF-selected audits every round. One missed round freezes rewards; two misses burn 30% of the onyx bond. Funding-linked newcomers pay twice the previous lease, making a 20-clone farm cost a geometric series. Auditors verify signed job hashes and funding ancestry on the ledger, so a copied relic cannot masquerade as independent labor, while an honest agent crosses the meadow once.
